answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47493 Country: India Title: can we wear lense on eyes during fast and can we do shave during fast Question: Can we wear lenses on eyes during fast and can we do shave during fast? Answer ID: 47493 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/891/L=11/1434) Yes, it is lawful to wear lenses in the state of fast as well it is alright to shave head, this shall not break the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
